name: Lumina Metals Corp.
summary: Lumina Metals Corp. acquires, explores and develops mineral properties in Canada and Poland, searching for copper, silver, lead and zinc. Its flagship asset is the Nowa Sol project in Lubuskie Province, Poland. Formerly Miedzi Copper Corp, it took its current name in 2024, was incorporated in 2010 and has its head office in Vancouver, Canada.
